name: Hiba Rikuto
source:
A slender bespectacled boy who attends an ordinary school in the suburbs. He is a short and somewhat unreliable boy.

He has a kind personality, and although he is a bit introverted, he is usually sociable. Although he doesn't show it outwardly, deep down he's obsessed with boobs and has a higher libido than most people and he can be a quite aggressive when aroused.

[spoiler] He is the host to the god of male genitalia. He is elevated to godhood for not only his sexual prowess but also for fathering children who themselves become gods. He frequently visits his children in heaven. [/spoiler]
